result.reply:
I can tell you what the listing says, but I can't judge whether the clause is legally enforceable. B-2002 is let with a Staffelmiete (graduated rent) that goes up by 3 percent every year [B-2002]. The rent is 2350 EUR/month [B-2002], and utilities are 320 EUR per month on top [B-2002].

Whether the clause holds up under Berlin's rent cap rules is a legal question, so I've passed it to a colleague (ticket T-a8e8320e). They'll follow up with you. If you'd like them to contact you by email, just send me your address.
